creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen in MIP-3 round 2 by a worker at load average ~50: muster pane new timed out twice (EAGAIN on the window's command socket) and each attempt still created a herdr pane that the window never displayed, leaving an orphan shell the caller cannot name. Related to a_2P65uphDZ (CLI requests time out on the keystroke budget) and a_2PSQUYmcH (a pane new --run whose split timed out). With MIP-3's daemon, a create that names its pane up front (the name is minted by Muster and passed in the request) makes a lost answer recoverable: the caller can ask for that name. Re-check after the cut-over; if it still happens, the CLI should report the pane name it asked for so the orphan can be found or closed.
title: A muster pane new that times out still makes a pane the window never shows
